name: Siphonarioi
headerMeta: Golden era · Ranged infantry (Exotic) · special · 300 leadership · Seasonal (Season V: Legacy of Fire)

origin.text: Seasonal Unit (Season V: Legacy of Fire)
unlock: Season 5 Legacy of Fire veterancy line - you need Ball Boys unlocked first

pitch: A unique flamethrower unit that puts out heavy sustained damage and crowd control from range, but it is genuinely fragile — even grey-tier trash kills it the moment it's exposed. Screen it behind a shield or infantry line and work it at chokepoints; caught alone in open ground with no frontline, it dies fast.

veterancy.label: Top line
veterancy.body: Flat fire-damage increase (roughly +240 per point, stacking to ~480) plus extra ammo capacity (60% + 10% ≈ 70% more) and cooldown reduction; ammo economy is the practical uptime limiter so the extra capacity is treated as close to mandatory.

veterancy.label: Bottom line
veterancy.body: Modest +20% defense mitigation — barely matters given how fragile this unit already is.

battleRole.positioning: Backline support, never frontline — even grey-tier enemies maul it if exposed, so it always needs a friendly screen (shields or other infantry) in front. {2} Tuck it into corners rather than right at the shield wall's immediate edge. {2}
battleRole.formation: Staggered formation or a single-file line. {2}
battleRole.tips: Never aim the direct-fire stream flat along the ground — angle it upward at a wall or raised surface near the enemy so it arcs down onto upper body/head level for more hits and kills. {2} Best worked at chokepoints (gatehouses, breaches, narrow corridors/stairwells), laying Scorched ground-fire to zone the area while it keeps pumping flame into a contained kill zone until it needs to resupply. {2} 2 → 1 combo maximizes damage but shouldn't be overused — only for defending/attacking a chokepoint like a gate, or when your 1 will hit the unit cap; even at a gate, 1 → 2 is better for longer CC uptime (noted as a pre-Spartans-release read). {1} In open space, do not use 2 → 1 — too much room to move and bigger frontlines; instead 2 → reposition → 1 diagonal/straight (situational — mixed vet can beat full Top line here), or 2 → 1 diagonal, or 2 diagonal → 1 straight. {1} 2 → 1 doesn't add much extra damage: burn duration and CC get reset by ticks from 1, so the only real gain from 2 is extra impact-damage ticks. {1}

cards.name: Axe Raiders
cards.why: hard counter — can leap directly over or through friendly shield lines onto exposed Siphonarioi

controls.notes: Direct-fire (1) is a targeted flame stream; Scorched (2) sprays hellfire across an area of terrain and is used to zone ground. {2} Ammo and health both burn fast — plan resupply trips rather than fighting to empty. {2} A shield-screened Siphonarioi grinding a chokepoint has been clocked around 76 kills in a single engagement before needing to fall back and resupply; poor cooldown timing (Scorched fired too early, direct fire off-target) lets even a cavalry push finish it off. {2}
